name: money
title: Money
about: Iris's ledger, synced from owner.db: transactions, bills and subscriptions, with charts. Iris owns the rows; you read them and write money.md.

routines.name: Nightly expense card
routines.action: Card with today's spending from the money app (transactions dated today, kind spend): the total, the top two categories, and anything unusual against the last 30 days. Category level only: no merchants or card digits on the card.
